result.instructions: Tools for SmartRecruiters, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs in our company are open right now, and how many candidates applied to each?"; "Show me the candidates who applied for the Senior Engineer job this week."; "What is the status of candidate 1234 for the Product Manager role?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SmartRecruiters data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smartrecruiters_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smartrecruiters_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smartrecruiters_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. smartrecruiters_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_search_jobs
tools.title: Search jobs
tools.description: Search the company's job requisitions by keyword, status, city, department or update time. Returns content with each job, totalFound and nextPageId. SmartRecruiters: GET /jobs.

q.description: Keyword to match in the job title, e.g. java developer.

city.description: City filter, case sensitive, e.g. San Francisco.

department.description: Department label filter, case sensitive, e.g. Marketing.

updatedAfter.description: Only items updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z.

pageId.description: Pass the nextPageId from the previous reply to read the next page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: Get one job requisition by id: title, status, location, department and hiring team. SmartRecruiters: GET /jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_search_candidates
tools.title: Search candidates
tools.description: Search candidates who have at least one job application, by keyword, job, status, tag or update time. Returns content, totalFound and nextPageId. Call one page at a time: this endpoint allows one concurrent request. SmartRecruiters: GET /candidates.

jobId.description: Only candidates who applied for this job id.

status.description: Candidate status in the context of a job, e.g. NEW, IN_REVIEW, INTERVIEW, OFFERED, HIRED.

tag.description: Only candidates with this tag, case insensitive.

updatedAfter.description: Only items updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z.

pageId.description: Pass the nextPageId from the previous reply to read the next page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_get_candidate
tools.title: Get candidate
tools.description: Get one candidate's profile by id: name, contact details, source, tags and properties. SmartRecruiters: GET /candidates/{id}.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_get_candidate_application
tools.title: Get candidate application
tools.description: Get one candidate's application to one job: status, substatus, rating and screening answers. SmartRecruiters: GET /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_list_candidate_attachments
tools.title: List candidate attachments
tools.description: List the files attached to a candidate, such as a CV or cover letter (metadata only). SmartRecruiters: GET /candidates/{id}/attachments.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_search_offers
tools.title: Search offers
tools.description: Search job offers by status, keyword or posting id. The key must belong to a user with the Extended or Admin system role. SmartRecruiters: GET /offers.

q.description: Full text query over offer name and description.

postingId.description: Job posting id from the job board.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the company, such as recruiters and hiring managers, with name, email and system role. SmartRecruiters: GET /users.

q.description: Full text query over first name, last name, email and external data.

updatedAfter.description: Only items updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z.

pageId.description: Pass the nextPageId from the previous reply to read the next page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_add_candidate_tags
tools.title: Add candidate tags
tools.description: Add tags to one candidate. Existing tags stay; this call never replaces or removes tags. Up to 100 tags, 150 characters each. SmartRecruiters: POST /candidates/{id}/tags.

tags.description: Tags to add to the candidate.
